description: Active in Set next week at the reckoning
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Kept the tucket out of the reckoning.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Active in Set next week at the reckoning
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Read the week, refused a share, and shut the leaf on the unpaid sums.
name: John Heminges

description: Made you say the week back, and sent you home.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept the first Caesar and the boys' wage off the leaf.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for the week when the money would not come, and took the river as the part worth remembering.
name: Will Kemp

description: Repeated the week, left the packet unwritten, and kept Anne's day unknown.
name: William Shakespeare
